method: Acorn AST source-ordinal scan of the original privately held ZIP; deterministic bundle ordinals; manual examination of selected function bodies without publishing source excerpts.
source_privacy: Only anonymous capture-local resource and function ordinals, fixed pattern labels, aggregate counts and original summaries.

reviewed_client_operations.description: A function begins with the selected current node, repeatedly looks up that node in a mapping, follows the parent reference, reverses the accumulated path and extracts available messages.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: Indicates a client-side traversal implementation; does not prove that a server persists data in the identical structure.

reviewed_client_operations.description: A related function walks selected-node ancestry, collects non-null messages, and stops at a message satisfying an injected predicate; its default predicate targets the user author role.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: Only the inspected function's local behavior is established; callers and UI ownership need separate tracing.

reviewed_client_operations.description: An asynchronous refetch routine examines current conversation state, optionally defers while streaming, and merges a fetched node mapping with locally held messages, preserving particular in-progress or newer message states.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: Client reconciliation and guards are visible, but network response timing and actual server semantics are unobserved.

reviewed_client_operations.description: A mapping reconciliation function adds locally held nodes absent from another mapping, finds a surviving parent or a root, appends child references and selects between current-node values based on availability and change.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: A concrete client-side graph operation; it is not confirmation of export schema stability or backend storage design.

reviewed_client_operations.description: An asynchronous client function invokes a branch method with the conversation identity and selected message identity; the call returns a new thread identity and conversation object that the client processes further.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: The method call and result handling are present statically, but endpoint names, wire protocol, actual server behavior and resulting persistence remain outside this proof.

reviewed_client_operations.description: A generation-dispatch routine selects a parent message using continuation, explicit parent, regeneration-from-message and existing child-branch information before preparing a new generation request.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: The routine's static fallback order is visible, but no particular branch was observed being chosen during a live request.

reviewed_client_operations.description: A client routine assembles the regeneration inputs, including the targeted message identity, a regeneration-options object and an explicit regeneration-from-message field, before dispatching the work.
reviewed_client_operations.limits: The source supports request assembly and delegation, not a verified transport payload or actual server outcome.

open_static_questions: Identify direct callers and imported consumers of the selected-ancestry functions, distinguishing chat UI code from generic tree libraries.
Trace the branch method's client-side return flow into conversation selection, navigation and local state.
Trace the fetch/reconcile operation's call-site triggers and the lifecycle of stream merge guards.
Recover the editor, regenerate, abort and retry function relationships from the same captured bundles.
Classify minified module boundaries, call aliases and dynamic import limitations without treating lexical proximity as an executable edge.
limitations: AST pattern matches are intentionally narrow and may include unrelated libraries.
Resource and function ordinals are stable only for this capture and extraction ordering.
Lexical enclosure is not an execution or call relationship.
Observed client code is not observed runtime behavior or a verified backend protocol.
No original JavaScript file, user identifier, message text, cookie, token, route, endpoint or payload is reproduced.

reviewed_module_exports.meaning: Selected-path materialization function is exposed by the captured module export table.
Predicate-limited ancestry traversal is exposed by the same module export table.
The asynchronous conversation-refetch function has an explicit descriptive export binding.
The conversation branch client function is exposed by its module export table.
The completion submission wrapper is exposed under a descriptive bundle export.
The local-function-result wrapper is exposed under a descriptive bundle export.
The regeneration assembly wrapper is exposed under a descriptive bundle export.
The work-handoff conversion wrapper is exposed by a static module export getter.
The answer-now steering wrapper is exposed by a static module export getter.

module_export_limitations: Module export bindings establish exposure inside captured JavaScript, not whether any caller was executed.

At the time of this initial module-export scan the UI importer chain was untraced; later E2-078 and E2-091 source reviews resolve selected typed-renderer/component links but not every dynamic feature importer.
Dynamic imports and runtime selection may prevent a captured module from running.
The six reviewed caller-to-dispatcher edges are direct calls within one captured module factory; no live dispatch or branch choice was observed.

reviewed_direct_calls.note: The captured completion submission wrapper directly invokes the shared generation dispatcher.
The captured local-function-result wrapper invokes the shared dispatcher.
A work-handoff conversion function assembles message, handoff-parent and conversion options and delegates to the shared dispatcher.
The regeneration request assembly function directly invokes the shared dispatcher.
A conditional retry-oriented wrapper also invokes the shared dispatcher.
A steering action requiring an active message submits a continuation with an answer-now steering flag through the same dispatcher.

reconciliation_with_later_studies.remaining: Not every imported consumer or dynamically loaded component is traced.
Observed server acknowledgement and cross-session durability are not established.
Conditional UI paths and runtime outcomes remain unverified.
Other dynamic imports and unresolved aliases remain.
